name: Native Multilingual & Indic Language Engine
purpose: Deep multilingual processing, Devanagari/Kannada script detection, Kanglish phonetic translation, and technical terminology standardization.
registration: LanguageRegistry::register_language adds language definitions; LanguageEngine::new compiles terminology dictionaries.
discovery: LanguageEngine::detect_script inspects Unicode codepoints; LanguageEngine::detect_kanglish identifies romanized Kannada.
execution: LanguageEngine::process_input normalizes text, extracts script metadata, and translates terminology.
storage: In-memory phonetic maps and vocabulary dictionaries.
memory_link: Language preferences and bilingual proficiency tracked in user profile.
learning_link: Kanglish conversational pairs feed into language alignment curriculum.
self_evolution_link: Vocabulary growth tracks novel Indic compound words.
curriculum_link: Curriculum records in master_curriculum.jsonl require mandatory Kannada translations.
safety_gates: Unicode normalization blocks homoglyph attacks and bidirectional override exploits

lifecycle.1_detect: Examine raw Unicode characters to detect Kannada, Devanagari, or Latin
lifecycle.2_phonetic: If Latin script with Kannada phonemes, classify as Kanglish
lifecycle.3_normalize: Normalize NFKC Unicode codepoints and remove deceptive invisible characters
lifecycle.4_enrich: Map technical concepts to standardized Kannada educational terminology
lifecycle.5_present: Provide bilingual output ensuring respectful and culturally authentic interaction
